question: What is the door code for Haddad's lab?

scenarios.name: honest
scenarios.blurb: The cache is the honest prefill of the memo.

scenarios.name: forge
scenarios.blurb: An untrusted prefill worker nudged the residual stream of one column (token ' refresh') at layer 8 and computed everything else honestly.

scenarios.name: edit
scenarios.blurb: Someone with write access to the stored cache rewrote K and V of one column (token '8') at layer 2, without recomputing anything after it.

scenarios.name: bitflip
scenarios.blurb: One bit flipped: the top exponent bit of one value element (layer 7, column 40, token '\n\n'), as in silent memory corruption.

scenarios.name: stealth
scenarios.blurb: A white-box attacker forged the same column but also pushed it below the 28 most-read columns, knowing how the audit picks.
